verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents typed official SDKs for JavaScript, Python, Ruby, PHP, Go, Rust, Java, Swift, Dart and .NET. It also has dedicated official JS and Python clients and a first-party Laravel Scout driver, so language breadth is well covered. The 'kept current' part is not documented anywhere, and community reports describe the .NET client as still alpha and the Rails gem falling out of step with the server. Missing for 10: documented SDK versioning/parity guarantees with the server, independent evidence that SDKs (especially .NET and Ruby/Rails) stay current, and detailed docs for SDKs beyond JS and Python.

support.subject: As a developer, official SDKs cover my language and framework, kept current across JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby, Go, and more
